run: ground-up rebuild — the previous visual system was rejected and replaced
direction: קו (The Route) — chosen by the user from three presented directions
designScoreNote: 4.00 mean. No open findings. This is a STATIC score: see unverified.
kept: Everything under src/services (geofencing, notifications, alarm, location, permissions, storage) plus hooks, state, utils, constants and types. None of it carried a visual opinion, and it is the part that took real work to get right.
src/utils/logger.ts, hardened this run to load outside Metro (__DEV__ is not defined in a bare Node context, which broke the new unit tests).
rebuilt: src/theme — deleted and rewritten as colors.ts + index.ts
src/components — every file replaced; icons are now Lucide rather than hand-drawn SVG
src/screens — HomeScreen, ActiveScreen (was PassScreen), AlarmScreen, PermissionsScreen
src/i18n — all strings rewritten for the new voice

findings.summary: White on the direction's green measured 3.24:1 and failed AA on the primary CTA; solved by putting dark ink on the fill rather than darkening the green, which would have cost the colour its character
The rail vanished on a cold start while armed, which is exactly when it matters; the stop list is now frozen into the persisted AlarmSession and restored by hydrate, never refetched

The store wrote the raw translation key 'errors.geofenceFailed' into `error`, which the screen renders verbatim; the user would have seen the literal key. Now resolved through t() at the point of failure
Arm failure was reported through Alert.alert, against the rule that modal alerts are for destructive confirmations only; moved inline next to the button that failed
Fonts reduced from three families to two and from six faces to five, still by weight subpath; IBM Plex Mono dropped entirely with the signage direction
LiveDot started its animation loop inside useMemo rather than useEffect, so it was never cleaned up on unmount

dismissed.reason: the only em-dash is in a file-header code comment, not a visible string
ScrollView over saved cards bounded at MAX = 12 in SavedStorage; a horizontal strip of 12 does not warrant FlashList
results are capped at 5 by GeocodingService and rendered in a plain View, not a ScrollView
both Alert.alert calls guard a destructive action (delete a saved destination, cancel the alarm) — the sanctioned use
0 emoji anywhere; every mark is a Lucide icon
0 orphan shadowColor; elevation() always pairs the iOS shadow with an Android elevation
0 inline hex in src/screens or src/components

dismissed.where: no skeleton on the alarm or permission screens
dismissed.reason: neither loads data; the only async content in the app is the stop list, which has a skeleton mirroring the rail's own layout
declared N/A in the App Read. The one network call degrades in place and is never on the alarm path

unverified: No simulator, emulator or device was reachable: dl.google.com and api.expo.dev are blocked by the environment's network policy, so no Android SDK and no cloud build.
NOT verified on a device: keyboard avoidance, splash-to-first-frame, scroll performance, font scale at 1.3x, edge-to-edge insets, haptics, alarm audibility, geofence delivery latency.

The Overpass request itself is unverified: overpass-api.de is blocked from this environment (proxy 403), so the query was written against the documented API and its degradation path rather than a live response.
First-impression narration and the Trunk Test were not run: they are live-pass instruments and a static review cannot fake them.
